item.title: CDC travel health notice, Level 1 - Global Dengue
item.description: Dengue is a year-round risk in many parts of the world, with outbreaks commonly occurring every 2–5 years. Travelers to risk areas should prevent mosquito bites. item.title: CDC travel health notice, Level 2 - Global Polio
item.description: Some international destinations have circulating poliovirus. Before any international travel, make sure you are up to date on your polio vaccines. Country List : Afghanistan, Algeria, Benin, Cameroon, Chad, Côte d'Ivoire (Ivory Coast), Democratic Republic of the Congo, Niger, Nigeria, Pakistan, Somalia, Yemen, Sudan, Angola, Ethiopia, Republic of South Sudan, Djibouti, Germany, United Kingdom, including England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland, Papua New Guinea, Central African Republic…

item.title: CDC travel health notice, Level 1 - Hepatitis A in Costa Rica
item.description: There is an outbreak of hepatitis A (HAV) in Costa Rica. Most cases have been reported in San José province.

item.title: CDC travel health notice, Level 2 - Yellow Fever in Colombia
item.description: An increased number of cases of yellow fever have been reported in Colombia.

item.title: CDC travel health notice, Level 2 - Chikungunya in Nicaragua
item.description: There is an outbreak of chikungunya in Nicaragua. You can protect yourself by preventing mosquito bites.

item.title: CDC travel health notice, Level 2 - Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda
item.description: CDC recommends practicing enhanced precautions for travel to Uganda or to provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) not affected by the current Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak. Country List : Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda Country List : Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda

item.title: CDC travel health notice, Level 1 - Paratyphoid Fever in Yemen
item.description: Cases of paratyphoid fever are being reported in returning travelers from Yemen. You can prevent paratyphoid fever by practicing safe eating and drinking habits.

item.title: CDC travel health notice, Level 1 - Diphtheria in Sub-Saharan Africa
item.description: There are outbreaks of diphtheria in several countries in Africa. Vaccination against diphtheria is essential to protect against the disease. item.title: CDC travel health notice, Level 2 - Zika in Indonesia
item.description: Cases of Zika are being reported in returning travelers from Bali, Indonesia. All travelers to Bali should take steps to prevent mosquito bites and sexual transmission of Zika virus during and after travel.

item.title: CDC travel health notice, Level 3 - Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease in Haut-Uélé and Tshopo Provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo
item.description: CDC recommends avoiding nonessential travel to Haut-Uélé and Tshopo provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) due to the current Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak.

item.title: CDC travel health notice, Level 4 - Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease in Ituri and Nord-Kivu Provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo
item.description: CDC recommends avoiding all travel to Ituri and Nord-Kivu (North-Kivu) provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) due to the current Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak unless traveling for humanitarian aid or emergency response.

item.title: CDC travel health notice, Level 2 - Chikungunya in Costa Rica
item.description: There is an outbreak of chikungunya in northwest Costa Rica. You can protect yourself by preventing mosquito bites.

item.title: CDC travel health notice, Level 1 - Diphtheria in Haiti
item.description: There is an outbreak of diphtheria in Haiti. Vaccination against diphtheria is essential to protect against the disease.

item.title: CDC travel health notice, Level 2 - Malaria in Yemen
item.description: Increased cases of malaria have been reported in Yemen, including in areas that were previously considered low-risk.

item.title: CDC travel health notice, Level 1 - Hepatitis A in Canada
item.description: Manitoba, Canada is currently experiencing a hepatitis A virus (HAV) outbreak. HAV is contagious and spreads through close person-to-person contact and by eating contaminated food or drink.

item.title: CDC travel health notice, Level 2 - Chikungunya in French Guiana
item.description: There is an outbreak of chikungunya in French Guiana. You can protect yourself by preventing mosquito bites.

item.title: CDC travel health notice, Level 2 - Malaria in Mayotte
item.description: Increased cases of malaria have been reported in Mayotte. Malaria is spread by the bite of infected mosquitoes.

item.title: CDC travel health notice, Level 2 - Chikungunya in Mauritius
item.description: There is an outbreak of chikungunya in Mauritius. You can protect yourself by preventing mosquito bites.

item.title: CDC travel health notice, Level 2 - Meningococcal Disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
item.description: There is an outbreak of meningococcal disease in the Mangembo Health Zone of Kongo Central Province. The best way to protect yourself is to get meningococcal vaccination.

item.title: CDC travel health notice, Level 2 - Chikungunya in Suriname
item.description: There is an outbreak of chikungunya in Suriname. You can protect yourself by preventing mosquito bites.

item.title: CDC travel health notice, Level 2 - Chikungunya in Bolivia
item.description: There is an outbreak of chikungunya in Santa Cruz and Cochabamba Departments, Bolivia. You can protect yourself by preventing mosquito bites.

item.title: CDC travel health notice, Level 1 - Rocky Mountain Spotted Fever in Mexico
item.description: Illness and death due to Rocky Mountain spotted fever (RMSF) have been reported in the northern region of Mexico along the U.S. border, particularly in Baja California, Sonora, Chihuahua, Coahuila, and Nuevo León.

item.title: CDC travel health notice, Level 1 - Global Measles
item.description: Measles cases are rising in many countries around the world. All international travelers should be fully vaccinated against measles with the measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine, according to CDC's measles vaccination recommendations for international travel. Country List : Afghanistan, Benin, Cameroon, Central African Republic, Chad, Côte d'Ivoire (Ivory Coast), Democratic Republic of the Congo, Djibouti, Ethiopia, Indonesia, Liberia, Nigeria, Pakistan, Republic of the Congo , Senegal, Somalia…
